semantic_counting.rule: Libraries, renderer helpers, bones, chain points and different constraints do not each count as creatures. Not Twilight Forest Naga. Existing credits are not cleared.

sculptor_complete_direct_chain.fact: Client constructs one GeckoDynamicChain per entity and publishes it through dynamicChains.

Pillar tick binds itself to caster sculptor; synced RISING/FALLING booleans and setters150-222 feed client entity tick. Simulation enabled if pillar absent/removed or neither rising nor falling. Caster superclass resolution and network delivery not fully read.

beard3→beard4→beard5Rot→beard6 are four ordered points. Model creates shared arrays once, passes into entity chain on animation setup. First two selected bones have cubes, next two are no-cube orientation endpoints; four points are not four separately rendered pieces.

Root interpolates previous anchor to authored current anchor over10 substeps. Non-root position uses previous-position displacement damping0.02 plus gravity0.1, mass1; projection enforces authored segment distance. Optional attraction disabled by default. Per-frame time derives tickCount+partial; paused skips solve. Gap>1 resets non-root p,p0,a to authored points.

Main pass hides original chain geometry and tracks bone matrices; then setChain/updateChain and recursively render parentless cloned bones under forced world matrices. Clone excludes dynamic-joint children to avoid repeat chain rendering. Afterwards original hidden state restored. Per-bone tracking is captured before translate-away-from-pivot.

alpha interpolates authored position toward simulated position; this is POSE BLEND, not opacity. Direction quaternion aims segments; scale comes from model-space matrix. Dynamic final endpoint has no aim to next point. No claim of exact pixels or normal correctness without runtime.

sculptor_limits: floorCollision and stiffness fields/setters exist, but neither participates in active Gecko solver: stiffness force line commented out. No block query, per-point terrain shape collision, self-collision or body pile.

Non-simulating branch snaps root to authored and blends other positions differently; it is not an independently verified stable reverse constraint. On death there is no dedicated chain cleanup/settling logic in the selected entity producer; no full death lifecycle claim.

Culled time gap reset is code-proven, not a verified teleport/late-observer guarantee. Reversed directions and coincident points may make quaternion normalization degenerate; no numerical execution performed.
Shared model arrays and per-entity state coexist; multi-entity/alternate render layer behavior requires runtime validation. No production adoption.

naga_complete_direct_chain.fact: Client entity creates DynamicChain dc. Model setDefaultAngle assigns tail=entity.dc and resets authored pose.
tailOriginal six points tail1..tail5,tailEnd; tailDynamic same length. renderToBuffer draws root, then tail.render cloned chain, and hides original showModel.
Animate calls setDefaultAngle first; dynamic update inside not-frozen branch after jawControls/wingFoldControls. Actual params gravity0.5,stiffness0.5,falloff0.5,damping0.97,substeps30,useFloor=true.

Each new entity tick reads authored point world positions; bend solver calculates angular restoring torque, gravity and damped angular velocities, reconstructing segment endpoints at fixed d. Render extrapolates p+v*partial+a*partial²/2. Outputs world positions converted to model space, plus pitch/yaw; renders all but terminal endpoint.

getWorldPos builds interpolated entity transform then calls MowzieRenderUtils.matrixStackFromModel; setWorldPos inverts entity transform and converts to16units/block. MowzieRenderUtils implementation missing in cached source: exact parent-transform traversal remains dependency gap.
MobRenderer binds ModelNaga; model dynamic tail is consumed by renderToBuffer. Mouth attachment updated after render for SPIT animation; no held/accessory asset work performed.

naga_limits: useFloor active only if entity.onGround and pointY<entity.getY; then subtracts a floor torque. No collision-shape sampling or position clamp. Not reliable terrain collision, not pile support.

Update once per entity tick; missed render ticks are not iterated as catch-up. Unlike GeckoDynamicChain no explicit time-gap reset. NaN check covers p[1].x and length mismatch; does not establish teleport stability.
Alternate updateSpringConstraint is not called by Naga updateChain; maxForce normalization result unassigned there. Do not treat that unused method as active mechanism.
Frozen branch and death animations not fully replayed. No gameplay, world screenshots or authored PNGs viewed.
